title: AI Learning and Knowledge Platform reference implementation outline
solution_outline: Begin with: Build a learning platform that helps learners explore topics, search trusted resources, practice concepts, and assess understanding.
Define inputs, outputs, baseline, and acceptance criteria before integrating an AI model.
Use synthetic or permitted data, validate every boundary, and keep credentials server-side.
Run fixed evaluation cases, inspect failure examples, and document results with versions and limitations.
Add explicit error states, access control, monitoring, and a rollback or human-review path appropriate to the impact.
review_notes: Structured course catalog and searchable learning content
Quizzes with answer validation and explanations
Evaluation set for relevance, factual support, and retrieval
Authentication, access control, data minimization, and secure configuration
Monitoring for latency, costs, failures, and quality regressions
Technical report with intended use, limitations, results, and safety choices
completion_standard: Completion requires evidence from the tests and rubric; a visually successful demo alone is not sufficient.
